ড. আহমদ আলী

Book

Shariah Compliance and Violations in Islamic Banking

Problems and Paths Forward

About this book

A research-based examination of Islamic banking in theory and practice. The book asks how Islamic banks should operate in light of their stated objectives, evaluates areas of Shariah compliance and violation in current practice, identifies institutional and operational shortcomings, and discusses possible paths for reform.
